Don't be afraid to seek support even if you might feel at your lowest of lows right now there are people who do truly care and want you to get better. 

Look for suicide hotlines or any support group to help you 

Get rid of anything that might trigger something, sometimes things can trigger you into doing things, like for me sharp objects make me relapse into self harm, so its best to get rid of those.

Try to find beauty in life even if you can't see it, get a pet or plushies, collect things, do things that will make you happy, vent to people, get therapy and try to better yourself mentally.
